title: Spectroscopic and QM/MM studies of the Cu(I) binding site of the plant ethylene receptor ETR1
authors: George Cutsail; Stephan Schott-Verdugo; Lena Müller; Serena DeBeer; Georg Groth; Holger Gohlke
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物乙烯受体ETR1的Cu(I)结合位点光谱与QM/MM模拟，虽涉及蛋白-配体结合但对象为铜离子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或DNA相关建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Herein, we present the first spectroscopic characterization of the Cu(I) active site of the plant ethylene receptor ETR1. The X-ray absorption (XAS) and extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) spectroscopy presented here establish that ETR1 has a low-coordinate Cu(I) site. The EXAFS resolves a mixed first coordination sphere of N/O and S scatterers at distances consistent with potential histidine and cysteine residues. This finding agrees with the coordination of residues C65 and H69 to the Cu(I) site, which are critical for ethylene activity and well-conserved. Further, the Cu K-edge XAS and EXAFS of ETR1 exhibit spectroscopic changes upon addition of ethylene that are attributed to modifications in the Cu(I) coordination environment, suggestive of ethylene binding. Results from umbrella sampling simulations of the proposed ethylene binding helix of ETR1 at a mixed quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) level agree with the EXAFS fit distance changes upon ethylene binding, particularly in the increase of the distance between H69 and Cu(I), and yield binding energetics comparable to experimental dissociation constants. The observed changes in the copper coordination environment might be the triggering signal for the transmission of the ethylene response.
abstract_zh: 在此，我们首次对植物乙烯受体ETR1的Cu(I)活性位点进行了光谱表征。本文所展示的X射线吸收（XAS）和扩展X射线吸收精细结构（EXAFS）光谱证实，ETR1具有低配位数的Cu(I)位点。EXAFS解析出第一配位层中N/O和S散射体的混合组成，其距离与潜在的组氨酸和半胱氨酸残基一致。这一发现与C65和H69残基配位至Cu(I)位点相符，这些残基对乙烯活性至关重要且高度保守。此外，ETR1的Cu K-edge XAS和EXAFS在加入乙烯后表现出光谱变化，这些变化归因于Cu(I)配位环境的修饰，提示乙烯结合。对ETR1提出的乙烯结合螺旋进行的伞形采样模拟，在混合量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）水平上，其结果与乙烯结合时EXAFS拟合距离的变化一致，特别是H69与Cu(I)之间距离的增加，并得出与实验解离常数相当的结合能量学。观察到的铜配位环境变化可能是传递乙烯响应的触发信号。
